doc.title: John Best interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998

title: Closing thanks
summary: Rowe thanks Best; Best would do it again if he could correct a few things.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well you’re certainly a popular man in the San Diego area, because all I’ve been hearing for the last couple of days is people saying, “John Best might come here, and we’ve got to see him.” And I know there’s some folks waiting for you downstairs that I hope you have a good time seeing. And I’ve really enjoyed talking to you, and reminiscing. And I think you’ve seen some great times in the music, and you certainly made a big contribution to this music over the years. Would you do it all over again?
I guess so. If I could correct a few things.
Okay. Well I want to thank you again for coming today, and it’s been a great pleasure for me.
On behalf of Hamilton College, thanks a lot.
